title: Grabby settings
description: Persisted at ~/Library/Application Support/Grabby/settings.json. Unknown keys are ignored; missing keys take defaults.

actionButton.description: CoreGraphics button number. 0 (left) and 1 (right) are never valid. null means not configured.

naturalDirection.description: null follows the system natural scrolling setting; true or false overrides it.

throwStrength.description: 0: the release position decides. 1: the hand's speed at release counts fully.

showTrail.description: Glowing pointer trail while the action button is held.
